newsitem.title: UKRAINE: FORECAST-Ukraine January inflation seen at 3.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Ukraine January inflation seen at 3.2 pct.

text.p: Ukraine's January inflation will quicken to 3.2 percent from 0.9 percent in December, central bank chief Viktor Yushchenko said on Thursday.
"January inflation will be about 3.2 percent and although this is a high rate for Ukraine, it is more than two times less than what it was last January," he said.
Ukraine has forecast annual inflation at 25 percent this year, from 39.7 percent in 1996 and 181.7 percent in 1995.
